**Liability Mechanism Comparison:**

| Mechanism Type | How It Works | Financial Impact (Sample $1M claim) | Risk to Buyer |
|----------------|-------------|-----------------------------------|---------------|
| **Deductible (Current):** Claims aggregated, Seller pays excess over threshold only | Buyer bears first $325,000; Seller pays $675,000 ($1M - $325,000) | Higher - Buyer bears initial loss | Medium |
| **Tipping Basket:** Claims aggregated, if total exceeds threshold, Seller pays all claims from first dollar | If claims exceed $325,000, Seller pays full $1,000,000 | Lower - Better protection once threshold breached | Low |
| **First Dollar:** No threshold, Seller liable from first dollar of claims | Seller pays full $1,000,000 | Lowest - Maximum Buyer protection | Low |
| **Proposed:** Reduce deductible to 0.25% ($162,500) | Buyer bears first $162,500; Seller pays $837,500 ($1M - $162,500) | Improved - Reduces Buyer's exposure | **Recommended** |
